briefing: - Junos 边界漏洞已入KEV且在野利用，EPSS 0.918，立即升级。
- Zammad 权限提升已入KEV，建议同步排查并尽快升级至修复版。
- Nginx-UI 多高危漏洞集中修复，含9.4分代码注入RCE，优先升级。
- 今日批量公告含多个9分以上SQL注入、文件上传、硬编码凭据，需资产排查。
- 本批未标记勒索软件关联，但仍应防范高EPSS漏洞被武器化。

items.title: Junos BIND TKEY查询拒绝服务
items.title_zh: Junos BIND TKEY查询拒绝服务
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者发送TKEY查询触发断言失败，导致named退出，DNS服务中断
items.action_zh: 升级到含BIND修复的Junos版本，临时限制TKEY查询
items.repro_note: 向DNS服务端口发送构造TKEY查询，无需认证，观察named退出
items.description: named in ISC BIND 9.x before 9.9.7-P2 and 9.10.x before 9.10.2-P3 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (REQUIRE assertion failure and daemon exit) via TKEY queries.

items.title: Zammad 本地权限提升至root
items.summary_zh: 已获zammad服务账号写权限的本地攻击者可提权至root，完全控制主机
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级至7.2.2及以上版本；限制服务账号写权限
items.impact_scope: 主机本地提权，影响Zammad服务
items.description: Zammad packages built with packager.io (DEB and RPM) could have allowed a local attacker who already had file system write privileges as the unprivileged zammad service account to escalate to full root privileges on the host. An attacker holding that foothold could have escalated within seconds, because the affected services were restarted automatically whenever they stopped; no administrator interaction was required.

items.title: Nginx-UI 备份恢复代码注入RCE
items.title_zh: Nginx-UI 备份恢复代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 已登录管理员通过/api/restore提交恶意备份，篡改app.ini实现命令执行
items.action_zh: 升级至修复提交后的版本；限制备份恢复权限
items.repro_note: 登录管理员向/api/restore提交恶意备份篡改app.ini
items.description: From 2.3.8 until 2.5.0, an authenticated administrator with an active secure session can submit attacker-controlled portable backup key material and a matching manifest to POST /api/restore. The restore flow trusts the supplied key, decrypts attacker-controlled contents, and replaces the live app.ini, including protected nginx command settings such as TestConfigCmd.

items.title: Nginx-UI 密钥泄露致认证绕过
items.title_zh: Nginx-UI 密钥泄露致认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 获取泄露密钥者可绕过密码/JWT/会话/2FA，获得持久管理员API权限
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；轮换泄露密钥和会话令牌
items.repro_note: 需先获取泄露密钥，再伪造API请求绕过认证
items.description: Nginx UI is a web user interface for the Nginx web server. A party that obtains the secret can bypass normal password, JWT, session, and second-factor checks and obtain persistent administrative API access, including access to configuration and secret material.

items.title: Nginx-UI 管理接口CSRF
items.summary_zh: 诱使已登录管理员浏览器发起跨站请求，可修改配置等状态操作
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；临时校验Origin/Referer
items.repro_note: 构造跨站表单诱导管理员触发POST /api/configs
items.description: Because management endpoints do not universally require a CSRF token or perform Origin or Referer validation, a remote attacker can induce a logged-in administrator's browser to submit authenticated cross-site state-changing requests, including POST /api/configs. The attacker cannot read the cross-origin response but can modify Nginx configuration, trigger reloads, or invoke other management operations reachable with the victim's session.

items.title: Nginx-UI 跨节点认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 持有同一令牌者可冒充可信节点，执行配置同步/服务重启等管理操作
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；轮换节点共享令牌
items.repro_note: 使用节点令牌作为X-Node-Secret访问集群管理接口
items.description: The same token is accepted as X-Node-Secret by AuthRequired and maps the request to initUser, allowing the user to impersonate a trusted node against a reachable cluster member. This cross-node authentication bypass can expose sensitive management operations, including configuration synchronization and service restart.

items.title: Nginx-UI 集群接口缺失授权
items.title_zh: Nginx-UI 集群接口缺失授权
items.summary_zh: 已认证但非安全会话可调用集群节点变更/重载/重启等管理操作
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制集群API访问
items.repro_note: 使用普通认证会话调用/api/cluster节点变更或重载接口
items.description: Nginx UI is a web user interface for the Nginx web server. From 2.0.0 until 2.5.0, the api/cluster router exposes node and namespace mutation operations and cluster-wide Nginx reload or restart operations with AuthRequired but without RequireSecureSession.

items.title: Nginx-UI 密码登录绕过Passkey
items.summary_zh: 获取密码者无需注册的Passkey即可登录并接管账户，访问管理功能
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；启用强认证并轮换密码
items.repro_note: 仅凭用户名密码登录，绕过Passkey二次验证
items.description: Nginx UI is a web user interface for the Nginx web server. An attacker who obtains the password can take over the account and reach administrative functionality without the registered passkey.

items.title: Nginx-UI 符号链接绕过写文件
items.title_zh: Nginx-UI 符号链接绕过写文件
items.summary_zh: 利用符号链接绕过文件限制，持久篡改配置或导致服务拒绝服务
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制配置目录写权限
items.repro_note: 通过符号链接指向敏感配置路径后触发写入
items.description: Nginx UI is a web user interface for the Nginx web server. This can persistently inject configuration or cause denial of service when the modified files are later consumed.

items.title: Vikunja API令牌权限提升
items.summary_zh: 低权限API令牌可越权访问同用户更高权限路由，读取或操作更多数据
items.action_zh: 升级至2.4.0；轮换API令牌
items.repro_note: 使用低权限API令牌调用超出声明范围的路由
items.description: The resulting credentials are not restricted by the original API token's permissions, allowing access to routes outside its declared scope for the same user. Version 2.4.0 fixes the vulnerability.

items.title: Nginx-UI 节点签名路径资源耗尽
items.title_zh: Nginx-UI 节点签名路径资源耗尽
items.summary_zh: 未验证签名前暂存并同步请求体，攻击者可耗尽磁盘/IO导致拒绝服务
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制请求体大小
items.repro_note: 向节点签名认证接口发送超大请求体，观察临时文件耗尽
items.description: From 2.5.0 until 2.6.0, the node-signature authentication path performs temporary file staging of an attacker-controlled request body and synchronizes it before validating the body digest and cryptographic signature. An unauthenticated remote client that can reach the API and provide syntactically valid signature metadata can consume temporary filesystem capacity, disk input and output, and request-processing resources before rejection.

items.title: Nginx-UI 升级包完整性校验缺陷
items.title_zh: Nginx-UI 升级包完整性校验缺陷
items.summary_zh: 能篡改镜像和摘要的攻击者可诱导管理员升级，执行恶意代码控制进程
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；校验升级包签名和来源
items.repro_note: 劫持升级源同时篡改二进制与摘要，触发管理员升级
items.description: A compromised mirror or network attacker able to alter both responses can supply a malicious executable and matching digest. An operator-triggered upgrade is required, and the application installs and runs the attacker-controlled code in the Nginx UI process context on the next upgrade.

items.title: PHPNuxBill 密码重置OTP暴力破解
items.title_zh: PHPNuxBill 密码重置OTP暴力破解
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者已知用户名可无限猜6位OTP，重置并读取新密码接管账户
items.action_zh: 限制OTP尝试并联系厂商获取修复
items.repro_note: 已知用户名请求忘记密码，爆破6位otp_code并读取响应
items.description: PHPNuxBill through 2025.3.20 contains an account takeover vulnerability in the customer password reset flow in system/controllers/forgot.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to brute-force the 6-digit otp_code. Attackers knowing a customer username can guess the code without attempt limits or lockout, then read the newly set password from the HTTP response to hijack the account.

items.title: Zombify 任意文件上传致RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可上传危险文件并写入Web服务器，可能部署WebShell执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 升级到修复版本；临时限制上传类型
items.repro_note: 向文件上传接口提交危险类型文件，验证可解析
items.description: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type vulnerability in PX-lab Zombify zombify allows Upload a Web Shell to a Web Server.This issue affects Zombify: from n/a through 1.7.7.

items.title: openPDC镜像硬编码管理员凭据
items.title_zh: openPDC镜像硬编码管理员凭据
items.summary_zh: 可访问管理接口的攻击者用镜像内置固定凭据登录，获得完全管理控制权
items.action_zh: 修改默认凭据；更新镜像或联系厂商修复
items.repro_note: 访问openPDC管理接口，用镜像内置固定管理员凭据登录
items.impact_scope: 电力/工控管理接口，内网
items.description: The published Docker image for openPDC includes a fixed administrative credential with no forced change on first use. An attacker with network access to the management interface can authenticate using this credential and gain full administrative control of the application.

items.title: PHPNuxBill 未授权SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向radius接口传构造参数，基于时间盲注窃取客户记录与凭据
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；过滤username/macAddr/nasid参数
items.repro_note: 未授权访问radius.php，对username等参数注入时间盲注
items.description: PHPNuxBill through 2025.3.20 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the radius.php FreeRADIUS REST endpoint that interpolates request parameters into whereRaw() queries. Attackers can send crafted username, macAddr or nasid parameters to the accounting or authenticate actions to extract customer records and credentials via time-based blind SQL injection.

items.title: lwIP SMTP客户端缓冲区溢出
items.title_zh: lwIP SMTP客户端缓冲区溢出
items.summary_zh: SMTP客户端未校验输入长度，恶意服务器或输入可触发溢出，导致代码执行或崩溃
items.action_zh: 升级lwIP修复版本；限制SMTP输入长度
items.repro_note: 配置lwIP SMTP客户端连接恶意服务器，发送超长响应
items.impact_scope: 嵌入式设备网络栈，物联网
items.description: lwIP SMTP client does not check the size of inputs, potentially allowing a buffer overflow.

items.title: Exposed SQL函数注入
items.summary_zh: 使用未转义字符串参数调用SQL函数时可注入，导致数据库数据泄露或篡改
items.action_zh: 升级到1.5.1版本；避免拼接未转义参数
items.repro_note: 调用相关SQL函数时传入未转义字符串参数构造注入
items.description: In JetBrains Exposed before 1.5.1 sQL injection was possible via unescaped string arguments of several SQL functions

items.title: gvproxy 未授权路径遍历删文件
items.title_zh: gvproxy 未授权路径遍历删文件
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者调用/services/forwarder/expose，通过路径遍历删除主机任意文件
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 联系Red Hat升级；临时禁用expose接口
items.repro_note: 未授权调用expose接口，传入../路径删除任意文件
items.impact_scope: 容器网络转发组件，宿主
items.description: A path traversal vulnerability was found in gvproxy, the network forwarder provided by the gvisor-tap-vsock package. The unauthenticated /services/forwarder/expose endpoint does not validate the caller-supplied socket path, allowing an attacker to delete arbitrary files on the host system.

items.title: Traveler 主题盲SQL注入
items.summary_zh: Traveler主题存在盲SQL注入，攻击者可注入查询窃取数据库敏感信息
items.action_zh: 升级Traveler至修复版本；过滤SQL参数
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Shinetheme Traveler traveler allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Traveler: from n/a through 3.2.9.

items.title: WPLMS插件盲SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过插件参数注入SQL，盲注读取数据库敏感信息，造成数据泄露。
items.action_zh: 升级到 1.9.9.8.2 或更高版本修复
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in VibeThemes WPLMS wplms_plugin allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects WPLMS: from n/a before 1.9.9.8.2.

items.title: JNews Pay Writer盲SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过该WordPress插件参数注入SQL，盲注读取数据库敏感数据。
items.action_zh: 升级该插件至 12.0.1 之后修复版本
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in jegtheme JNews - Pay Writer jnews-pay-writer allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects JNews - Pay Writer: from n/a through 12.0.1.

items.title: tagDiv订阅插件盲SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过 tagDiv Opt-In Builder 参数注入SQL，盲注读取数据库敏感信息。
items.action_zh: 升级该插件至 1.7.6 之后修复版本
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in tagDiv tagDiv Opt-In Builder td-subscription allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects tagDiv Opt-In Builder: from n/a through 1.7.6.

items.title: Ajax Search Pro盲SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过 Ajax Search Pro 插件参数注入SQL，盲注读取数据库敏感数据。
items.action_zh: 升级该插件至 4.29.1 之后修复版本
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in wpdreams Ajax Search Pro ajax-search-pro allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Ajax Search Pro: from n/a through 4.29.1.

items.title: EduAdmin Booking盲SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过 EduAdmin Booking 插件参数注入SQL，盲注读取数据库敏感信息。
items.action_zh: 升级到 6.0.0 或更高版本修复
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in MultiNet Interactive AB EduAdmin Booking eduadmin-booking allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects EduAdmin Booking: from n/a before 6.0.0.

items.title: Contao评论组件存储型XSS
items.summary_zh: 未认证访客提交恶意评论，后台管理员打开评论模块时触发XSS，可劫持会话。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级到 5.3.50 或 5.7.12 修复版本
items.repro_note: 入口：评论提交的 email/website 字段；前置：管理员打开后台评论模块
items.description: From version 4.0.0 until 5.3.50 and 5.7.12, an unauthenticated visitor can submit a comment whose email or website metadata is rendered without sufficient attribute and URL encoding by listComments() in comments-bundle/contao/dca/tl_comments.php. When a backend user opens the Comments module, attacker-controlled script can execute in the Contao backend origin under that user's session.

items.title: TinaCMS预览源校验缺陷
items.summary_zh: 攻击者诱使已登录编辑打开恶意链接，利用受信预览框架以其凭据执行GraphQL读写受保护内容。
cwe_labels: 意图代理错误(混源下载)
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级到 3.14.0 或 @tinacms/app 2.5.14
items.repro_note: 入口：恶意预览链接；前置：编辑已登录并打开链接，触发GraphQL操作
items.impact_scope: TinaCMS后台，编辑权限越权读写
items.description: An unauthenticated attacker can send a crafted link to a signed-in editor, cause the admin to frame an attacker origin, and have that frame treated as the trusted preview. The attacker-controlled frame can submit GraphQL reads or mutations that the admin executes with the editor credentials, exposing or modifying protected content.

items.title: FalkorDB Bolt越界写入
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者向Bolt端口发送特制WebSocket帧，触发堆越界写，导致拒绝服务或内存破坏。
items.action_zh: 升级到 4.20.0 或更高版本
items.repro_note: 入口：Bolt端口WebSocket帧；参数：64位扩展负载长度
items.impact_scope: 图数据库Bolt端口，暴露可致DoS
items.description: A heap-based out-of-bounds write in the ws_read_frame function (src/bolt/ws.c) and the buffer_apply_mask function (src/bolt/buffer.c) in FalkorDB before 4.20.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial of service and possibly corrupt heap memory by sending a WebSocket frame with a 64-bit extended payload length to the Bolt port.

items.title: FalkorDB RDB越界读取
items.summary_zh: 能发送Redis复制命令的攻击者（如无密码配置）通过特制RDB流触发越界读，导致拒绝服务或堆内存泄露。
items.action_zh: 升级到 4.18.4 或更高版本；配置Redis密码
items.repro_note: 入口：Redis复制命令/RDB流；前置：可发复制命令，如无密码配置
items.description: A heap-based out-of-bounds read in the BufferSerializerIOv2_ReadBuffer function (src/serializers/serializer_io.c) in FalkorDB before 4.18.4 allows a remote attacker who can issue Redis replication commands (for example, against an instance with no password configured) to cause a denial of service or disclose heap memory by supplying a crafted RDB stream whose sub-buffer length field exceeds the remaining buffer size.

items.title: Enclave OS Mini 未授权 源校验错误(SSRF类)
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Enclave OS Mini is a Rust-based runtime for confidential applications inside Intel SGX enclaves. An attacker who obtained an enclave TLS private key could relay a genuine quote onto another connection, causing a relying party to accept an attacker-terminated connection as the attested enclave.

items.title: 未授权 源校验错误(SSRF类)
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Privasys rustls is a maintained fork of the rustls TLS library that adds RA-TLS challenge and channel-binding support. An attacker who obtained an enclave TLS private key could relay a genuine quote onto another connection, causing a relying party to accept an attacker-terminated connection as the attested enclave.

items.title: 未授权 源校验错误(SSRF类)
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Privasys Go is a maintained fork of the Go programming language that adds RA-TLS support to crypto/tls. An attacker who obtained an enclave TLS private key could relay a genuine quote onto another connection, causing a relying party to accept a handshake terminated by the attacker as an attested enclave connection.

items.title: 未授权 源校验错误(SSRF类)
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Enclave OS Virtual runs container workloads inside confidential virtual machines with end-to-end attestation. An attacker who obtained an enclave TLS private key could relay a genuine quote onto another connection, causing a relying party to accept an attacker-terminated connection as the attested enclave.

items.title: 未授权 源校验错误(SSRF类)
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Remote Attestation TLS Clients provides multi-language utilities for verifying attested TLS connections. An attacker who obtained an enclave TLS private key could relay a genuine quote onto another connection, causing the clients to accept an attacker-terminated connection as the attested enclave.

items.title: Flask应用模板注入致RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可利用模板注入执行系统命令，窃取Flask密钥、数据库及服务凭据，并产生存储XSS。
items.action_zh: 暂无修复版本信息，限制模板可控输入并轮换密钥
items.repro_note: 入口未知，需确认模板注入点及可控参数；关注Flask模板渲染
items.impact_scope: 未知Flask应用，凭据与主机风险
items.description: This could execute operating-system commands as the application user, disclose the Flask SECRET_KEY, access connected service credentials and the database, and produce stored cross-site scripting.
